_meta.part_hint: MM32SPIN05PF / MM32SPIN27PS — Chinese MindMotion brushless-motor MCUs
_meta.source: MindMotion MM32SPIN0X user manual (Mandarin Chinese; rough translation from datasheet tables). MM32 cores are typically Cortex-M0+ with STM32F0-like peripherals. TIM1 acts as the advanced-control timer with complementary outputs.
_meta.notes: Best-effort transcription. Verify against vendor datasheet for production use. Hoverboards using this chip typically have identical phase pinout to STM32F0-class chips.
